objective: Strengthen behavioral discrimination for recommendation_engine (C42.21: 282 generated, 163 killed, 119 survived, 57.8%).
strategic_constraint: Strengthen genuine threshold/metric/ordering behavior; classify (not chase) equivalent mutants.
approach: Existing 36 tests covered primary thresholds. Added 9 deterministic behavioral tests pinning exact metric strings, the FOIR CRITICAL boundary at exactly 0.60, the subscription-growth boundary at exactly 25%, new-subscription (LOW) classification, and deterministic severity ordering.

validation.targeted_mutation: Manual mutant (debt metric percentage = int(ratio*100)+1) caught by test_debt_dependency_metric_string_is_exact_percentage (test FAILS on mutant, proving mutation sensitivity).
validation.method_note: Full 282-mutant component re-measurement is performed by the authoritative CI campaign (Batch 6 trigger) per program policy; local targeted validation confirms the new tests kill representative Class-A mutants.

survivor_classification.expectation: Remaining survivors after full re-measurement are predicted to be Class B (equivalent arithmetic on metric strings / ordering coincidences) and Class C (unreachable branches).
survivor_classification.class_B: Metric-string formatting mutants whose visible output is identical for valid-domain inputs; severity-order default coincidences.
survivor_classification.class_C: Defensive branches unreachable under the function contract (e.g., None handling already covered).

exit_gate.meaningful_mutation_improvements_evidenc: spot-check killed representative Class-A metric/threshold mutants
